chapter: Looking back: rock, blues, childhood and guitar innovators
title: Joe Pass, Kenny Burrell, Lee Ritenour and other young guitarists
summary: Collins is proud of a crop of young guitarists, including his student Lee Ritenour, whom he heard with Nelson Riddle.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: and of course another young guitarist is Joe Pass. Of course Joe's not that young, but I -- how old -- I think Joe is around --he's got to be in his late forties. Kenny Burrell. About 41. But you have some other young guitarists. I have some students who are marvelous guitarists. Very good technique, you have Lee Ritenour. Baby. And he's a monster. He's about 21?

About 21. He looks like he's 12. You know, I did a thing with Nelson Riddle a few months ago and they had two guitarists and Lee Ritenour was there, and I was just thrilled to hear him. I feel proud of him, you know, and I really do. This is how I feel about him because they contribute and they inspire me, you know. So we have a wonderful crop of young guitarists coming up now, and it's exciting. I enjoy it very much.
